# We Are In Collective

> We Are In is a growth partner, not a marketing agency, based in Kottayam, Kerala, India. Marketing is one of the tools. Clarity is what we actually sell. We join your business — we don't work for it.

A growth partner sits inside a business and works on the whole of it: what the business means, who it is for, how leads are handled, what it charges, what it should stop doing — and only then the marketing. We would rather lose the project than recommend the wrong thing.

Who it is for: founders and owners of small and mid-sized businesses who are starting, growing, stuck, scaling or reinventing, and who want an honest read on what is actually wrong before anyone spends on marketing.

Contact: hello@wearein.in · St. Mary's Arcade, Near Nalumanikkattu, Thiruvalla – Ettumanoor Bypass, Kottayam, Kerala.

- [Growth diagnosis](https://wearein.in/diagnosis/): fifteen questions about your business and an honest first read of where it stands. Free, under five minutes.
- [What is a growth partner?](https://wearein.in/growth-partner/): a definition, and how it differs from a marketing agency, a consultant and a fractional CMO.
- [Before you hire an agency](https://wearein.in/before-you-hire-an-agency/): twelve questions to ask any marketing agency — and us.
- [Contact](https://wearein.in/contact/): a conversation, not a pitch. A human replies, usually the same day.
